snippet.title: EGO 2 | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Besimi tronditet kur zbulon se nusja e ardhshme e djalit të tij është pikërisht vajza që ai kishte operuar fshehurazi, për të mbuluar një të kaluar që askush nuk duhej ta mësonte.

Kur Xhulia i rrëfen se pas këtij sekreti fshihet Lalani, trafikanti që e kishte dhunuar dhe që tashmë ndodhet në burg, Besimi i kërkon t’i tregojë Minos të vërtetën — ndërsa vetë hesht për sekretin që e lidh me të.

Nga qelia, Lalani nis një lojë hakmarrjeje të pamëshirshme. Një plan i përpiktë, që pas sulmit ndaj Xhulias, e bën edhe Besimin të dyshojë se autori mund të jetë vetë djali i tij.

EGO 2 është një thriller i fuqishëm ku e vërteta, faji dhe hakmarrja përplasen në një kurth që mund të shkatërrojë një familje të tërë.

🎬 Në kast:
Bujar Asqeriu, Raimonda Bulku, Zamira Kita, Sejfulla Myftari, Laert Vasili, Drilon Hoxha, Dritan Boriçi, Gjergj Doçi, Xhulia Musagalliu, si dhe shumë emra të tjerë të njohur të kinematografisë shqiptare.

She's unlike anybody he's ever met. From M. Night Shyamalan, #RemainMovie is in theaters Valentine's Day 2027.

From Warner Bros. Pictures, Remain, starring Jake Gyllenhaal, is an unprecedented collaboration between two of the world’s most creative minds: best-selling author Nicholas Sparks, and visionary filmmaker M. Night Shyamalan.

When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

Gyllenhaal stars alongside Phoebe Dynevor, Ashley Walters, Julie Hagerty and Jay O. Sanders.

◾️INTRODUCTION
The globally beloved manga DRAGON BALL by Akira Toriyama continues to captivate fans through a wide range of media—from TV animation, movies, games, and merchandising—standing as a top-ranked title with extraordinary worldwide popularity. 
Now, in 2026, the anime Dragon Ball Super, original work, story, and character design by Akira Toriyama, is set to begin anew as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus! This ENHANCED edition introduces a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, as well as a reconstructed narrative. With cutting-edge visual expression, the series delivers even more immersive battle scenes and a more faithful representation of the original manga—bringing an ENHANCED edition to life like never before.

Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus’s overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.
Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an Earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his allies—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.
